title: Workplace Fire Safety Basics
subtitle: A short lesson with a knowledge check
summary: Covers extinguisher use, evacuation routes, and how to raise the alarm.

lessons.text: Remember the PASS technique for a fire extinguisher: Pull the pin, Aim at the base of the fire, Squeeze the handle, and Sweep from side to side.
Know at least two evacuation routes from your work area. If the nearest exit is blocked, the second route keeps you from getting trapped.
On discovering a fire, raise the alarm first, then only attempt to fight small, contained fires — and never at the cost of your own escape path.
